en: Let us rejoice and be glad,
awake, brothers, with a joyful heart.
notes: The text gives each line once; in performance every line is repeated ("Hava nagila, hava nagila, hava nagila ve-nismecha …"), and "uru achim" is sung over and over before the close.
The first line echoes Psalm 118:24, "This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it."
